Questions

How long does the Mass run?

Between an hour and an hour and a half. The reception begins at half past six at Base Eleven Convention Centre in Pala, about half an hour away by road.

Is there parking?

There is ample parking at both the church and the convention centre.

May I take photographs?

During the Mass, please leave the aisle to our photographers and take what you like from where you are seated. Afterwards, everything is fair game.

My plans have changed. What now?

Tell us as soon as you know. There is no such thing as too late to let us know either way.
